core.reason: Protect accepted parser behavior from executable regressions.
core.run_when: Runtime code, parser fixtures, or construction tests change.

core.reason: Keep current construction notes structurally aligned with runtime labels and test files.
core.run_when: Runtime labels, construction notes, statuses, or construction test metadata change.

core.reason: Prevent accepted UUID-keyed adjudications from drifting from their canonical records.
Protect permanent UUIDs, short codes, aliases, and lifecycle coverage.
core.run_when: Identity, adjudication, runtime-label, or source-path data change.

core.reason: Detect stale deterministic readiness outputs after their canonical inputs change.
core.run_when: Identity, evidence, status, corpus, panel, test, or readiness inputs change.

core.reason: Ensure every parked entry resolves to one current identity and unlisted constructions remain available.
Keep the sole current project snapshot synchronized with canonical counts.
Prevent broken current-document links and competing current authority.
core.run_when: Current documentation, authority settings, or canonical state changes.

research.reason: Prevent missing, duplicate, malformed, or overclaimed research provenance records.
research.run_when: Research packages, source ledgers, evidence grades, or provenance configuration change.

release.reason: Block linguistic status promotion unless the permanent evidence gates are satisfied.
release.run_when: Status, promotion evidence, panel, corpus, or boundary records change for a promotion decision.

release.reason: Block release publication when version, package, or handoff invariants are incomplete.
